zh.summary: 更小、更快、更完整的便携桌面版：带走工作区、会话、设置和插件，并在新电脑上直接继续使用。
highlights: Windows 运行环境改为一次准备、后续复用的紧凑封装；完整包只需展开少量产品文件，减少解压、复制、移动和删除时的小文件负担。
新增完整的数据迁移流程：可导出普通迁移包或密码保护的私密包，并在新的 Portable 环境中预览内容、处理冲突后导入。
插件市场重新融入 DSH 原生插件页，支持即时显示本地目录、后台刷新、安装、更新、卸载和诊断；插件名称直接进入作者项目。
新建环境默认离线提供可卸载的 DSH Native Session Manager 与 DSH Native Image Viewer，之后仍按标准插件方式更新和管理。
Portable 本体与官方 DeepSeek Harness 内核使用独立更新通道；小更新可原地验证、安装和失败回滚，兼容边界变化时会引导完整包升级并保留数据。
Windows 桌面壳、托盘、工作区选择、文件下载、通知、退出释放和首次启动经过统一收敛，窗口不再暴露浏览器界面。

en.summary: A smaller, faster, and more complete portable desktop: carry workspaces, sessions, settings, and plugins, then continue on another PC.
highlights: The Windows runtime is now a compact prepare-once package that is reused on later launches. Complete downloads expand into far fewer product files, reducing extraction, copy, move, and deletion overhead.
A complete data migration flow can export a regular transfer package or a password-protected private package, preview it in a fresh Portable environment, resolve conflicts, and import it.

Plugin Market now fits directly into the native DSH Plugins page with an immediate local catalog, background refresh, install, update, uninstall, diagnostics, and direct links to each author's project.
Fresh environments include the removable DSH Native Session Manager and DSH Native Image Viewer offline, while standard plugin update and management remain in control afterward.

DSH-Portable and the official DeepSeek Harness core use separate update channels. Compatible updates install transactionally with verification and rollback; compatibility changes guide a full-package upgrade while preserving data.
The Windows shell, tray, workspace picker, downloads, notifications, shutdown release, and first launch are now one coherent desktop flow without exposing browser chrome.
